notes: Intended network: Sepolia (11155111), selected by the deployment system. LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol takes no constructor arguments. AllowlistClaim in src/AllowlistClaim.sol takes one immutable bytes32 root and has no token dependency, owner, setters, upgrade path, payable entry points, or external calls. Leaves are keccak256 of packed 20-byte addresses; proof pairs are sorted before hashing. Claims only record membership and confer no token entitlement. The constructor root is the four-account public Anvil demo tree documented with members and a proof in reports/gas-and-size.json and covered by the fixed-vector test. This configures a demonstration allowlist, not a publisher-supplied live allowlist. No Sepolia deployment receipt is present in the accepted tree. No initialization calls are required. The pool pairs with native ETH and has no hook; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 equal to 2^96. The README reports 435 runtime bytes and 46,359 gas for a local successful claim with a two-sibling proof.
